@mschf x @lexususa present MOTOMORPHOSIS\
On view now, during Armory Week 2026.\
Opening night drinks and bites provided by Lexus Culinary Master Esther Choi @choibites \
\
Public Opening 9\/24 from 7-9pm\
Viewing Hours 9\/25-26, 10am-6pm\
\
Location: Chelsea Industrial, 535–551 W 28th St\
\
motomorphosis.com\
\
*Dramatization

MOTOMORPHOSIS presents sculptural transformations of two Lexus vehicles altered through a recurring MSCHF motif—applying the vernacular of digital-native operations to physical objects—alongside their source material, the Lexus RX Plug-In Hybrid and RZ All-Electric. Twisted and stretched into abstraction, blurring consumer luxury and sculptural form, the works imply motion the way animation’s smear frames do. Distorting beyond realistic shape so that, played back, movement becomes fluid, true to the car’s nature, not the constraints of reality. #LexusRX #LexusRZ\
\
